newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia faces more spending cuts - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia faces more spending cuts - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said there would be more spending cuts announced in the 1997/98 (July-June) budget, to be announced in May.
"There will be further spending cuts," Howard said during a radio interview on the Australian Broadcasting Corp.
"But nothing like last year (1996/97), but there will be some spending cuts," he said.
The government announced A$7.2 billion of savings in last year's budget.
